title: Client onramp status lab report - 2028-07-10
body:
Weekly sync notes from Solutions Eng + ProServices lab checkpoint (informal capture)
Date: 2028-07-10
Lead facilitator: Ava Martinez
Attendees: Ava, Ravi, Maya, Ethan, Jordan, Claire (SRE - partial), PM: Sofia (listening)
Meeting length: 40m
Purpose: quick health sweep for active onramps, surface regressions, confirm next-week capacity/eng needs, and capture immediate escalations.

Top-line summary:
- Three customers in final integration sprint: NorthPoint Retail (NP), Helios Bank (HB), Arcadia Health (AH).
- NP: functional but experiencing degraded p95 latency for inference during batch onboarding; SRE + runtime investigating kernel selection mis-match.
- HB: blocked on VPC peering + cert rotation; expected unblock after security sign-off late 7/12.
- AH: on schedule, but needs additional evals for quantized variant accuracy drop at long prompts.
- Two smaller pilots (sandbox) moved to canary routing; no major issues.

Agenda items / notes:
1) NorthPoint Retail (NP) - status: yellow
   - Recent work: completed schema mapping for product catalog ingestion; prefix caching enabled for product search templates.
   - Observed issue: p95 token latency spiked from 220ms -> 480ms during simulated 2k RPS onboarding window. Spike correlates with change to kernel profile (PR#87), introduced last Thursday.
   - Troubleshooting so far: kernel rollback to previous profile returns p95 to ~240ms in dev load test. KV cache hit-rate steady at 82%.
   - Hypothesis: kernel selection heuristic picks non-optimized matmul kernel when sequence length variance > 1.5x.
   - Action items:
     * Ethan: run targeted profiler across 8-hour window and dump kernel decision logs (due 2028-07-12). Linked jira: JIRA-SE-4983.
     * Claire (SRE): provision temporary dedicated pool (2x A100 equivalent) to validate runtime isolation effect on observed latency (due 2028-07-13).
     * Ravi: coordinate rollback plan with NP infra and schedule a 30m validation window (due 2028-07-12).
   - Questions: do we want an automatic retrain of kernel selector on NP traffic profile or keep manual for now? (tentative: manual until next sprint)

2) Helios Bank (HB) - status: red -> yellow TBD
   - Recent work: completed private control plane install on customer edge; initial model artifacts replicated.
   - Blocker: VPC peering failing due to route propagation policy on HB side; certificate rotation for mTLS pending compliance sign-off.
   - Business impact: HB will not begin production validation without peering and cert rotation completed; they are on a regulatory timeline (deadline 2028-07-20).
   - Action items:
     * Maya: own cross-org escalation to security + infra (copy legal) to accelerate cert sign-off; include security checklist and acceptance criteria (due 2028-07-11).
     * Jordan: open direct support channel with HB network team, collect traceroute + BGP dump (due 2028-07-11).
     * PM Sofia: draft contingency (limited feature pilot) to keep legal timeline while peering completes (due 2028-07-12).
   - Risks: if sign-off slips past 7/15 we may need to re-negotiate go-live window and Dedicated commit.

3) Arcadia Health (AH) - status: green with a flagged concern
   - Recent work: model variant rollout completed; canary to 10% for clinical summarization flows.
   - Concern: quantized 4-bit variant shows a subtle drop in ROUGE-L on long discharge summaries (>2,000 tokens). Short prompt performance unchanged.
   - Tests: eval harness run on holdout set shows -4% relative ROUGE-L on long docs; token-level hallucination rate unchanged but factuality score decreased for named entities.
   - Action items:
     * Ravi + Solutions Eng bench: run ablation with mixed-precision profile (8/4 hybrid) and report quality delta (due 2028-07-14).
     * Customer: AH data team to provide 50 additional long-doc examples for focused eval (requested by 7/11).
   - Decision point: if hybrid reduces quality loss <2% we will keep quantized route; else fallback to float32 with cost impact assessment.

4) Sandbox pilots (two small pilots) - status: green
   - Both pilots moved to canary routing with auto-fallback enabled. No notable errors. Token consumption within expected envelope.

5) Operational / capacity notes
   - Dedicated capacity queue: two requests pending (NP temporary pool + HB dedicated for compliance testing). Current forecasted utilization next week: 78% (baseline) + 18% incremental if NP temporary pool approved.
   - Autoscale policy tweak: recommended temp increase to max-burst for NP validation windows; SRE to gate via runbook.

6) Open blockers & escalations
   - JIRA-SE-5021: HB VPC peering: blocking cert rotation. Linked to legal review. Priority: P0 for next 72h.
   - Internal decision: enable expedited on-call rotation for network team if HB sign-off at risk (SRE to confirm availability).

7) Next week focus (7/13 - 7/20)
   - Short-term: close NP latency regression, unblock HB peering + certs, AH quantization eval.
   - Mid-term: draft playbook for kernel selector fallback and automatic safe-rollback thresholds (owner: Ethan, due 7/24).

8) Notes to self / informal TODOs captured in meeting (shorthand)
   - call out need for better long-doc eval sets in client onboarding checklist
   - add step in onramp for "kernel-selector smoke test" before kernel profile changes land in prod
   - re-check SSO onboarding doc to ensure HB compliance bits are present

Action items summary (owner — task — due):
- Ethan — profiler + kernel logs for NP — 2028-07-12
- Claire (SRE) — temp dedicated pool for NP validation — 2028-07-13
- Ravi — rollback & validation schedule w/ NP — 2028-07-12
- Maya — escalation to security/legal for HB cert sign-off — 2028-07-11
- Jordan — network diagnostics + HB contact channel — 2028-07-11
- PM Sofia — contingency pilot draft for HB regulatory timeline — 2028-07-12
- Ravi & SE bench — hybrid precision eval for AH — 2028-07-14
- AH data team — extra long-doc samples — requested 2028-07-11

Files / refs shared in meeting:
- Confluence: Onramp Playbook (linked above)
- JIRA: JIRA-SE-4983 (NP kernel regression), JIRA-SE-5021 (HB peering)
- GitHub: onramp-templates PR#87 (kernel changes)

Session retrospective (2 min):
- What went well: quick alignment on NP mitigation path; clear owners for HB escalation.
- What could be better: more preflight tests for kernel selector changes; improve long-doc eval coverage in onboarding templates.

End of notes — capture for distribution to SE leads and PMs.
If anything is missing or inaccurate ping Ava.Martinez@redwood.internal — will iterate and mark final after confirmations.
